signature.name: VTask.Bounded
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> [Preorder α] -> Ordnode α → WithBot α → WithTop α → Prop

conventions.statement: When the tree is nil and both lo and hi are finite (Some values), VTask.Bounded nil lo hi is definitionally equal to lo < hi.
conventions.note: This means the predicate is not trivially True for nil when both bounds are given; the bounds must be consistent.

conventions.point: nil with at least one infinite bound
conventions.statement: When the tree is nil and lo = ⊥ or hi = ⊤ (or both), VTask.Bounded nil lo hi is True.
conventions.note: The infinite bound cases are handled separately and are trivially satisfied.

conventions.point: top and bottom as unconstrained sentinels
conventions.statement: Setting lo = ⊥ and hi = ⊤ expresses the pure internal BST ordering of the tree with no external constraints.
conventions.note: This is the idiomatic way to check whether a tree is internally well-ordered without caring about its relationship to an enclosing context.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [Preorder α] (t : Ordnode α) (lo : WithBot α) (hi : WithTop α), VTask.Bounded t lo hi → VTask.Bounded t ⊥ ⊤
